integrity: The proof derives the Gini mean difference as four times a covariance with the mid-distribution transform, computes the latter's variance exactly by randomized probability integral transformation, and carries the Cauchy--Schwarz equality condition through to a complete fixed-profile support classification. Exact-rational computation replays but does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The atom-profile refinement is stated for finite discrete distributions.
The min-max order-statistic corollary assumes reflection-symmetric probability profiles and supports.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent formulation in older L-moment or midrank literature.
title: Sharp atom-profile refinement of the Gini–variance inequality
